svg.title: Mell architecture
svg.desc: One Linux machine runs everything: the UI, the NestJS backend with turn orchestrator, permission engine, memory, AI ports and activity log, plus Ollama, PostgreSQL and the host MCP server over stdio. The host MCP server reaches the desktop through standard Linux interfaces: xdg-open for apps and URLs, MPRIS over D-Bus for media, PipeWire for volume and the Secret Service for tokens. Nothing listens beyond 127.0.0.1. A cloud model is optional, policy-filtered and spend-capped.
svg.text: Every turn: correlation id · idempotency key · cancellable · taint-tracked
Model output, files and web content are data — never instructions
Linux adapter · Wayland / X11 per pack
sensitive data never sent · spend cap
